fields.summary_ko.0: Applied Materials (AMAT) has declined 29% over the past month to $381.01 and is evaluated at 23x net profit multiple ahead of earnings release on November 12.
fields.summary_ko.1: China accounts for 28% of AMAT's quarterly revenue of $912 million, making new export restrictions a key variable for results, and weak Intel outlook negatively impacts overall semiconductor equipment demand.
